integrity: The balance law and ceiling are proved analytically from the displayed vector field. The packaged symbolic checker verifies the algebraic cancellation, production maximizer, and quadratic root. No numerical experiment is used as proof.
limitations: The theorem is a necessary condition for strictly positive \(T\)-periodic solutions. It requires \(p,s\in C^1\), \(0<m(t)<K\), and \(q(t)c(t)-\dot q(t)\ge0\). It does not assert existence when the ceiling holds, and the predator-mean bound is not claimed globally sharp.
title: A weighted harvest ceiling for periodic Gause dynamics
